propositions: The autouse _no_repo_commits guard executes git rev-parse HEAD before and after each test, projecting ~207 runner-seconds or 75s wall-time overhead across the 13k-test suite on macOS.
Per-test HEAD moves are currently detected by subprocess calls; an in-process fingerprint approach requires safe handling of symbolic refs, packed refs, detached HEAD, and linked worktrees.

Candidate solutions (Git library dependency, hand-parsing refs, removing per-test attribution) were evaluated against OSS consensus and fidelity constraints and none met automatic approval; operator disposition is required.
The session dirty-tree backstop and per-test allow_repo_writes escape hatch must remain unchanged and operational.
Four surveyed OSS projects (pytest, pip, Poetry, pre-commit) all avoid per-test source-checkout Git subprocesses, confirming directional consensus for performance improvement.
